title: There's always a bigger fish (Stockfish and Bobby Fischer)
post: Every engine is a fish. Bobby Fischer was the fisherman. 🎣 Are you the fish or the fisherman? #chess #bobbyfischer #stockfish #chessedit #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: The strongest chess player on Earth is a fish. And it only dared to come up after one man died.
phrases.say: [mysterious] The strongest chess player on Earth... is a fish. And it only dared to come up... after one man died.

phrases.text: Stockfish. Nineteen engine world titles, twelve in a row. Every engine is food for it. Humans? Not even close.
phrases.say: Stockfish. Nineteen engine world titles... twelve in a row. Every engine is food for it. Humans? [scoffs] Not even close.

phrases.text: But there's always a bigger fish.
phrases.say: [dramatic] But there's always... a bigger fish.

phrases.text: Bobby Fischer. In German, Fischer means fisherman.
phrases.say: Bobby Fischer. In German, Fischer means... fisherman.

phrases.text: At thirteen, the Game of the Century. At fourteen, champion of America.
phrases.say: At thirteen... the Game of the Century. At fourteen... champion of America.

phrases.text: Then twenty wins in a row against the best in the world. 6–0. 6–0.
phrases.say: Then twenty wins in a row against the best in the world. [excited] Six–nothing. Six–nothing.

phrases.text: In 1972, he took on the Soviet chess machine alone, and reeled in the world title.
phrases.say: In nineteen seventy-two, he took on the Soviet chess machine alone... and reeled in the world title.

phrases.text: Every grandmaster was a fish. He was the fisherman.
phrases.say: [proud] Every grandmaster was a fish. He was... the fisherman.

phrases.text: Then he walked away from his title without a single game, and vanished for twenty years.
phrases.say: Then he walked away from his title without a single game... and vanished for twenty years.

phrases.text: The man who caught them all came to hate the game.
phrases.say: [quietly] The man who caught them all... came to hate the game.

phrases.text: He died in January 2008, at sixty-four: one year for every square of the board.
phrases.say: He died in January two thousand eight, at sixty-four... one year for every square of the board.

phrases.text: That November, with the fisherman gone, the fish came up. Its name: Stockfish.
phrases.say: That November, with the fisherman gone... the fish came up. [whispers] Its name... Stockfish.

phrases.text: So in your games, are you the fish, or the fisherman?
phrases.say: [curious] So in your games... are you the fish, or the fisherman?
